items.title: Henry Russ Interview, 1972-01-18
items.q: I left the band, and he got Alfred Williams to play in the band.

ctx.x: Put you in the air, that's what happened to his hobby.

That was his hobby. That was Chris Keller's hobby. Yeah. And uh. So it was an entirely different kind of music from Peele. Oh yeah, he was a fan that got Lombardi Band. Drick the music. And then you left Peele to go home. Well, after Peele got bad, we spent a little recording, and we went to the Peele, and we went to the Peele. So he phoned out to meet and things. I'd come on to, one night, depression, I'd sit in and say, Jesus, a butler rat. He told me a butler rat, he called him Gae. He saw it, one got killed.…
He's really fast with your cousin. The band has gone and fell it down? Correct.
